source_title: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind
work_or_witness: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind, Vol. 1, VIZ paperback edition
description: A young princess with an empathic bond with the giant Ohmu insects and animals of every creed. VIZ's selected Volume 1 synopsis says she works toward tolerance, understanding, and patience among empires fighting over remaining natural resources.

roles_and_vocations.note: Directly described by VIZ's selected Volume 1 synopsis; no kingdom, succession, or formal governmental power is inferred.

power_traditions.term: empathic bond with Ohmu and animals
power_traditions.note: Directly described in the VIZ Volume 1 synopsis. Its mechanism, limits, and real-world analogies are not asserted.

narrative_archetypes.note: A cautious narrative label based only on the stated effort toward tolerance among resource-conflicting empires.

canon_status: Synopsis-level character in the selected VIZ Volume 1 manga witness.

supports: Nausicaä is a young princess with an empathic bond with Ohmu and animals.
She seeks tolerance, understanding, and patience amid imperial conflict over resources.

comparison_cautions: The selected synopsis does not establish exact social culture, people/faction membership, aircraft, artifacts, toxic-ecology mechanics, detailed powers, injuries, illness, disability, or later development.
Her fictional empathy with creatures is not equivalent to any real-world ability, illness, disability, or cultural tradition.
Do not import events or characterization from the 1984 film, later manga volumes, guidebooks, games, translations, or adaptations.
